name: Evildoers
overview: Scripture reveals that evildoers, those who practice iniquity and follow detestable and abominable ways, are objects of God's hatred and will face just recompense for their actions (Proverbs 6:16; Ezekiel 11:21). Believers are cautioned not to fret or envy these workers of iniquity but to recognize that outward appearances and human esteem do not align with God's judgment, which discerns the heart (Psalms 37:1; Luke 16:15). Ultimately, entrance into the kingdom of heaven is reserved for those who do the will of the Father, while evildoers are destined for everlasting punishment (Matthew 7:21; Matthew 25:46).
